title: Local DVRs and orders are unchanged at rational points after field extension
statement: Let $k\subseteq k'$ be an extension of algebraically closed fields [def-sc-field-extension], let $X$ be a smooth proper connected curve over $k$ [def-sc-curves], and let $P$ be a $k$-rational closed point of $X$. Write $X'=X\times_kk'$ [def-pc-base-change] and let $P'$ be the unique point of $X'$ above $P$. Then $\mathcal O_{X,P}$ and $\mathcal O_{X',P'}$ are discrete valuation rings, and for every $f\in k(X)^*$ with pullback $f'\in k(X')^*$ the normalized orders agree: $v_{P'}(f')=v_P(f)$ [def-sc-divisor].

The field-extension map is flat, its base change is flat, and its local stalk map is faithfully flat, hence injective. proof.text: The proved private helper ord_eq_of_stalk_uniformizer derives coheight one from the DVR dimension. Choose an irreducible t. Write every nonzero source stalk element as u*t^n using IsDiscreteValuationRing.eq_unit_mul_pow_irreducible. Ring.ordFrac_of_isUnit and Ring.ordFrac_irreducible show that the stalk orders agree. IsFractionRing.div_surjective extends the equality to all rational functions. Unfold ordHom at coheight one to obtain precisely the Scheme.ord equality.
